summary: Many farmers struggle gorwing crops due to changing weather conditions and increaseing climate growth. Our goal is to help farmers deal with this and create better crop rotations.
details:
TerraPod is a farming monitoring system that combines local sensor readings with NASA environmental data. It measures temperature, humidity, light, and collected rainfall, detects loud sounds, and provides a live camera view.

We used Arduino IDE to program the ESP32 microcontrollers in C++, read the sensors, control the LCD, LED, and motor, and transmit readings through Bluetooth. Using Visual Studio Code, we developed a Python Flask backend and an HTML, CSS, and JavaScript dashboard that displays readings, compares them with NASA data, suggests crops, and saves records to Google Sheets.

3D printing helped us create a custom structure for mounting and organizing the electronics, camera, and sensors into one prototype.
